title: Sushi Sort 3D
tagline: Tap plates to sort sushi by color. 30 chibi-cute levels for short browser breaks.
description: Sushi Sort 3D is a cute 3D color-sort puzzle for short browser sessions. Tap a sushi plate to pick up its top piece, then tap another plate to drop it — but only on an empty plate or one whose top sushi already matches. Your goal: sort every plate so each one holds only one type of sushi. Featuring 30 hand-tuned levels of escalating difficulty (4 to 7 plates, 2 to 5 sushi types), a daily challenge plate seeded fresh every midnight, par-based 3-star ratings, an undo button for fearless experimenting, juicy 3D rice-and-topping models, soft Japanese izakaya wood-and-paper backdrop, procedural Web Audio koto-and-pad ambient music, satisfying clink-and-pop SFX, gentle bloom and vignette post-processing, full screen-shake on completed plates, mobile portrait safe-area support, and one-tap PWA install. Designed for adults during short breaks: one level lasts 30 seconds to 2 minutes, plays beautifully on portrait mobile, and never wastes your time with forced ads. Find the seed plate, watch the rainbow stack collapse into orderly monochrome towers.

controls.en: Tap a plate to pick up the top sushi. Tap another plate to drop it (must be empty or top must match).
controls.ja: 皿をタップして一番上の寿司をつまむ。別の皿をタップで置く（空、または一番上が同じ種類のときだけ）。

engineNotes: Next.js 16 App Router (Turbopack) + React Three Fiber + drei + postprocessing. 30 procedurally seeded levels with reverse-shuffle solvability guarantee. Procedural Web Audio. No external assets except Google Fonts.
